topic: AI tool tutorial: use Gemini's new Connected Apps in 3 steps
post:
Stop copy-pasting between your AI chat and your work apps. 🔌
Google just connected 14 more apps to Gemini. Here's how to use them in 3 steps.

What's new (rolling out since Sep 23):

💼 Productivity: Airtable, Linear, monday.com, PandaDoc, Wispr AI, Zoho
🎨 Creativity: Adobe, Picsart, Squarespace, Webflow
🏃 Lifestyle: apartments.com, Experian, Peloton, SeatGeek

How to try it:

1️⃣ Open the Gemini app and connect an app in Settings (or just ask Gemini to)
2️⃣ Type @ and the app name in your prompt
3️⃣ Ask for the outcome, e.g.:
"@monday.com create a task board for next week's product launch with owners and due dates"

⚠️ Heads-up: 10 of the 14 are US-only for now. Outside the US, Adobe, monday.com and Wispr AI are available, in English.

Why it matters:
AI is moving from "answer my question" to "do the work where my work lives." Fewer tabs, fewer copy-pastes.

Practical takeaway:
Before you connect any app, check what access you're granting. Start with one low-risk workspace, not your most sensitive one.

Which app would you connect to your AI assistant first? 👇
